parent_observation.interpretation_before_new_measurement: Stock-state risk scaling is worth mechanism attribution; dual-horizon IC gating did not earn its complexity because ungated beat gated.

data.crypto: qndata.cryptodaily_load_data; output universe remains contemporaneous is_liquid only
data.stock_membership: use each panel's historical is_liquid field; no static ticker list

portfolio.stock_role: global gross exposure only; never selects coin identity
portfolio.gross_mapping: exp(log(0.25) * risk_score), where risk_score is clipped to [0,1]

families.thesis: Broad, synchronized downside equity tails represent systemic risk appetite contraction that should lower crypto gross.
families.primitive: historical constituent standardized returns and historical membership
families.transform: median of robust scores for downside-tail breadth, downside commonality, and tail-breadth acceleration

families.thesis: Deteriorating equity participation, failed rebound after shocks, and correlation snapback reveal fragile risk appetite before outright trend collapse.
families.primitive: historical constituent returns, breadth and equal-weight panel return
families.transform: median robust score of breadth-price divergence, failed-recovery pressure and short-minus-long commonality

families.thesis: A tiny causal rolling linear model can combine stock states into a next-session crypto-market return forecast more effectively than a fixed hand-weighted composite.
families.primitive: six stock-panel state features with crypto market return used only as fully realized rolling training label
families.transform: 504-session rolling ridge regression trained through t-1 labels realized by t; negative standardized forecast maps to risk
families.ablation: univariate stock equal-weight market return predictor under same rolling ridge machinery
families.falsifier: invert the sign of forecast-derived risk

families.thesis: The change in equity commonality is a more causal systemic transition object than its level.
families.transform: short-versus-long commonality acceleration with dispersion-collapse interaction

families.thesis: Equity realized-volatility curve curvature and vol-of-vol acceleration contain transition information beyond a single fast/slow ratio.
families.primitive: equal-weight constituent return and constituent realized vol
families.transform: 10/21/63/126-day curve curvature plus vol-of-vol and cross-sectional vol spread

families.thesis: Divergence and lead-lag between independently measured S&P and Nasdaq systemic states is itself a risk-appetite transition signal.
families.primitive: independently computed historical S&P and Nasdaq stock-panel states
families.transform: absolute disagreement and fixed directional lead-lag alternatives
families.ablation: mean of two panel risk states

promotion_logic: Do not use 2023-2024 or 2025+ to tune or rescue a family.
A wave-1 primary must improve the 2016-2022 development Sharpe versus the unchanged parent and beat its destructive inverted control to support the claimed direction.
If the ablation matches or beats the composite on 2016-2022, complexity is not earned.
Panel agreement is supporting evidence; a result that works only on one panel is treated as fragile unless the mechanism explicitly predicts panel specificity.
Full-period Sharpe > 1 remains only the contest eligibility check, not sufficient promotion evidence.
No post-result parameter expansion within this experiment.
